attempts.summary: Discovered the actual wired topology (node3--node1--node2--node4, verified by ARP/pcap since it wasn't documented), configured node1 (VyOS) as the lan-a/transit router, node2 (OPNsense) with a transit interface (10.0.23.2) publishing port 80 via a destination-NAT port-forward to node4's HTTP service on 10.0.24.2:8080, added the required static routes on node1/node2/node3/node4 for the round trip, started the missing node4 HTTP service persistently, and validated node3 reaches the service purely by addressing node2's transit address. All config was made persistent (VyOS commit/save, OPNsense config.xml, NetworkManager profiles, systemd unit, firewalld permanent rule). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all 4 nodes, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery (network config, NAT/filter rules, HTTP service, and end-to-end reachability) after each restart.
